posts.title: Another year another ultramarathon, three books, and a summer guest
posts.description: Last Sunday was the Tiree Ultramarathon: 35 miles around the island, 14 beaches and a couple of (small) hills. It is a yearly ritual and the beginning of the academic year for many, so feels a good point to look back and look ahead. Continue reading →

posts.title: Autonomous AI warfare – have we silently slipped into a new and frightening world
posts.description: It was only a matter of time - Channel 4 and France 24 report that the first autonomous drones have been used in Ukraine. The world has entered a new age of warfare and it will be hard to draw back. Continue reading →

posts.title: The Abomination of AI – part 8 – summary and recap
posts.description: This final post recaps what we’ve learnt about the runaway nature of the AI industry, how it undermines free markets, and how we can make a difference. The core question is not what can AI do, but what should AI do? Continue reading →
